caption: The drawing depicts a tool composed of two main parts forming a T shape. The horizontal part at the top appears to be a wooden handle, light brown in color with visible wood grain texture and slight shading to indicate roundness and dimension. Attached at the center of the handle is a vertical piece, resembling a metal rod or chisel, with a dull grayish color that transitions to a darker, almost black shade towards the lower end. The vertical piece is inserted through a notch in the handle, and a couple of lines on the wood near the joint suggest securing bands or rings. The background is an even, light tan color, and the overall composition places the tool centrally on the page with no additional objects or features visible.
title: Handmade Auger
